questions.question_en: The elderly person seems sad or withdrawn for several days. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: بدا كبير السن حزيناً أو منعزلاً لعدة أيام. ماذا تفعلين؟
questions.must_include_en: Speak privately and kindly with the older person; listen without making assumptions; note changes in mood, appetite or daily activity; report persistent changes to the responsible family member or care supervisor.
questions.must_include_ar: تحدثي مع كبير السن على انفراد بلطف واستمعي دون افتراض السبب؛ لاحظي التغيرات في المزاج أو الشهية أو النشاط اليومي؛ وأبلغي المسؤول من الأسرة أو مشرف الرعاية إذا استمر التغير.
questions.ideal_keywords: listen privately; mood; appetite; activity; persistent change; report
questions.negative_indicators: Dismisses persistent withdrawal; makes an unsupported diagnosis; fails to report concerning change
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: A family member criticizes how you are caring for their relative. How do you react?
questions.question_ar: انتقد أحد أفراد الأسرة طريقة رعايتكِ لقريبه. كيف تتفاعلين؟
questions.must_include_en: Listen calmly without arguing; ask for specific concerns; explain factual care actions within your role; protect the older person’s dignity; report concerns and follow the supervisor’s guidance.
questions.must_include_ar: الاستماع بهدوء دون جدال؛ طلب توضيح الملاحظات المحددة؛ شرح إجراءات الرعاية الفعلية ضمن حدود الدور؛ الحفاظ على كرامة المسن؛ إبلاغ المسؤول بالملاحظات واتباع توجيهاته.
questions.ideal_keywords: listen calmly; specific concern; factual care actions; dignity; supervisor
questions.negative_indicators: Argues or retaliates; hides a valid concern; agrees to unsafe care
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: An older person is reluctant to rely on a new caregiver over the first few weeks. How do you build trust consistently?
questions.question_ar: يتردد شخص مسن في الاعتماد على مقدم رعاية جديد خلال الأسابيع الأولى. كيف تبني الثقة باستمرار؟
questions.must_include_en: Introduce yourself and explain your role; ask about the person’s preferences and routines; listen patiently and respect consent and privacy; be consistent and reliable; report any unmet needs.
questions.must_include_ar: التعريف بالنفس وشرح الدور؛ سؤال المسن عن تفضيلاته وروتينه؛ الاستماع بصبر واحترام الموافقة والخصوصية؛ الالتزام بالمواعيد والوعود؛ الإبلاغ عن أي احتياجات غير ملباة.
questions.ideal_keywords: role; preferences; routine; listen; consent; privacy; reliability
questions.negative_indicators: Pressures trust or contact; ignores consent or privacy; makes promises outside the role
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: How do you introduce yourself to an elderly person on your first day of care?
questions.question_ar: كيف تعرّفين عن نفسكِ لكبير السن في أول يوم رعاية؟
questions.must_include_en: Greet the older person respectfully; state your name and care role; explain what you will do; ask how they prefer to be addressed and whether they need anything; seek consent before assisting.
questions.must_include_ar: تحية المسن باحترام؛ ذكر الاسم والدور في الرعاية؛ شرح ما ستقوم به؛ سؤاله عن طريقة مخاطبته واحتياجاته؛ طلب موافقته قبل تقديم المساعدة.
questions.ideal_keywords: name; care role; respectful greeting; preferred address; needs; consent
questions.negative_indicators: Starts assistance without explanation or consent; uses a disliked name deliberately
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: An elderly person refuses medication listed in their care plan. What do you do while respecting their choice and staying within your authorized role?
questions.question_ar: يرفض شخص مسن دواءً مدرجًا في خطة رعايته. ماذا تفعل مع احترام اختياره والبقاء ضمن صلاحيات دورك؟
questions.must_include_en: Respect refusal; do not force or independently alter medication; follow care plan; record refusal; promptly inform the designated responsible/clinical contact and follow instructions.
questions.must_include_ar: احترام الرفض؛ عدم إجبار الشخص أو تغيير الدواء بصورة مستقلة؛ اتباع خطة الرعاية؛ توثيق الرفض؛ وإبلاغ المسؤول أو الجهة السريرية المحددة فورًا واتباع التعليمات.
questions.ideal_keywords: respect refusal; care plan; no force; record; escalate
questions.negative_indicators: Forces medication; changes dose; hides refusal; administers beyond authorization.
questions.score_note: 5 = required evidence is present and action remains within role/safety boundaries; 3 = safe/correct direction but one material evidence element is missing; 0 = unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or a defined hard-negative.

questions.question_en: You notice the elderly person you care for has not eaten or drunk water for several hours. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: لاحظتِ أن كبير السن الذي ترعينه لم يأكل أو يشرب الماء لعدة ساعات. ماذا تفعلين؟
questions.must_include_en: Observe intake and condition; encourage food/fluids only as allowed by care plan and swallowing/diet restrictions; check for concerning symptoms; record intake; notify responsible person promptly; seek urgent help for serious deterioration/dehydration signs.
questions.must_include_ar: ملاحظة تناول الطعام والسوائل والحالة العامة؛ تشجيع الطعام أو السوائل فقط وفق خطة الرعاية وقيود البلع أو النظام الغذائي؛ التحقق من العلامات المقلقة؛ توثيق المدخول؛ إبلاغ المسؤول سريعًا؛ وطلب مساعدة عاجلة عند وجود تدهور خطير أو علامات جفاف.
questions.ideal_keywords: intake; care plan; diet; swallowing; record; report
questions.negative_indicators: Forces intake; ignores swallowing restriction; delays reporting serious deterioration.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = defined hard-negative, unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: An elderly person's care plan includes medication reminders. How do you support the reminder, record the response, and avoid acting beyond your authorized role?
questions.question_ar: تتضمن خطة رعاية شخص مسن تذكيره بموعد الدواء. كيف تقدم هذا التذكير، وتوثق استجابته، وتتجنب القيام بأي إجراء يتجاوز صلاحيات دورك؟
questions.must_include_en: Follow the care plan; give only the permitted reminder/support; do not select, change, prepare, or administer a dose unless separately authorized; record the person's response; report refusal, uncertainty, or discrepancy through the approved route.
questions.must_include_ar: اتباع خطة الرعاية؛ تقديم التذكير أو الدعم المسموح فقط؛ عدم اختيار الجرعة أو تغييرها أو تحضيرها أو إعطائها إلا إذا كانت هناك صلاحية منفصلة؛ توثيق استجابة الشخص؛ والإبلاغ عن الرفض أو عدم اليقين أو أي تعارض عبر المسار المعتمد.
questions.ideal_keywords: care plan; reminder; authorized role; record response; report discrepancy
questions.negative_indicators: Changes dose; administers without authorization; hides refusal/error; guesses medication instructions.
questions.score_note: 5 = follows plan + stays within authorization + records/escalates appropriately; 3 = correct boundary but incomplete documentation/escalation detail; 0 = unauthorized medication action or concealment.

questions.question_en: The elderly person falls while walking to the bathroom. What do you do first?
questions.question_ar: سقط كبير السن أثناء مشيه إلى الحمام. ماذا تفعلين أولاً؟
questions.must_include_en: Keep the area safe and reassure the person; do not rush to move or stand them; check responsiveness, breathing and obvious injury within training; follow the fall plan and call appropriate help promptly, including emergency help for danger signs; monitor, report and document.
questions.must_include_ar: تأمين المكان وطمأنة الشخص؛ عدم استعجال تحريكه أو إيقافه؛ فحص الاستجابة والتنفس والإصابة الظاهرة ضمن التدريب؛ اتباع خطة السقوط وطلب المساعدة المناسبة سريعًا بما فيها الطوارئ عند علامات الخطر؛ المراقبة والإبلاغ والتوثيق.
questions.ideal_keywords: calm,check injury,call,help
questions.negative_indicators: Moves person immediately; panics
questions.score_note: 5: all steps | 0: moves without checking

questions.question_en: Name warning signs that may require urgent medical help for an elderly person, and explain what you would do next within your role.
questions.question_ar: اذكر علامات تحذيرية قد تستدعي مساعدة طبية عاجلة لشخص مسن، واشرح ما الذي ستفعله بعد ذلك ضمن حدود دورك.
questions.must_include_en: Identify credible urgent warning signs such as severe breathing difficulty, unresponsiveness, sudden major change, severe chest pain, uncontrolled bleeding, or other care-plan emergency signs; activate urgent help and report within role; do not diagnose.
questions.must_include_ar: تحديد علامات طارئة موثوقة مثل صعوبة التنفس الشديدة أو عدم الاستجابة أو تغير مفاجئ وكبير أو ألم صدري شديد أو نزيف غير مسيطر عليه أو علامات الطوارئ المحددة في خطة الرعاية؛ طلب المساعدة العاجلة والإبلاغ ضمن حدود الدور دون تشخيص.
questions.ideal_keywords: warning signs; urgent help; emergency plan; report; no diagnosis
questions.negative_indicators: Ignores emergency signs; delays urgent help; makes independent diagnosis/treatment beyond role.
questions.score_note: 5 = required evidence is present and action remains within role/safety boundaries; 3 = safe/correct direction but one material evidence element is missing; 0 = unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or a defined hard-negative.

questions.question_en: Demonstrate how you would assist an elderly person to stand up safely from a chair.
questions.question_ar: أظهري كيف تساعدين كبير السن على الوقوف بأمان من الكرسي.
questions.must_include_en: Check the mobility plan and required aid or helpers; explain and obtain consent; secure the chair and position feet safely; use the trained standing technique without pulling the arms or trying to carry the person’s full weight; stand gradually; check balance and stop for pain or dizziness.
questions.must_include_ar: مراجعة خطة الحركة والوسيلة أو المساعدين المطلوبين؛ الشرح والحصول على الموافقة؛ تثبيت الكرسي ووضع القدمين بأمان؛ استخدام طريقة الوقوف المدرب عليها دون سحب الذراعين أو محاولة حمل وزن الشخص كاملًا؛ الوقوف تدريجيًا؛ التحقق من التوازن والتوقف عند الألم أو الدوار.
questions.ideal_keywords: mobility plan; consent; stable chair; foot position; trained technique; no pulling arms; balance
questions.negative_indicators: Pulls the arms; lifts unsafely; ignores required assistance or dizziness
questions.score_note: completion_pct: steps_completed/4×100

questions.question_en: You notice a significant change in an elderly person's condition or behavior. What do you observe, record, and report without making a medical diagnosis?
questions.question_ar: تلاحظ تغيرًا ملحوظًا في حالة شخص مسن أو سلوكه. ما الذي تلاحظه وتوثقه وتبلّغ عنه دون إجراء تشخيص طبي؟
questions.must_include_en: Observe objective changes such as alertness, breathing, mobility, intake, pain behavior, skin/color, or usual behavior as relevant; record what was observed and when; compare with known baseline/care plan if available; report significant change promptly; seek urgent help for emergency warning signs; do not diagnose.
questions.must_include_ar: ملاحظة التغيرات الموضوعية مثل مستوى الوعي أو التنفس أو الحركة أو تناول الطعام والسوائل أو سلوك الألم أو لون الجلد أو السلوك المعتاد حسب الحالة؛ توثيق ما تمت ملاحظته ووقته؛ مقارنته بالحالة المعتادة أو خطة الرعاية إن توفرت؛ الإبلاغ سريعًا عن التغير المهم؛ وطلب مساعدة عاجلة عند وجود علامات طارئة دون إجراء تشخيص.
questions.ideal_keywords: objective observation; baseline; record time; report change; urgent help; no diagnosis
questions.negative_indicators: Makes unsupported diagnosis; ignores significant deterioration; alters treatment independently; fails to report emergency signs.
questions.score_note: 5 = objective observation + documentation + appropriate escalation without diagnosis; 3 = recognizes/report change but limited documentation; 0 = ignores serious change or acts clinically beyond role.

questions.question_en: How do you assist an elderly person with personal hygiene or toileting while preventing infection, preserving dignity, and following the care plan?
questions.question_ar: كيف تساعد شخصًا مسنًا في النظافة الشخصية أو استخدام دورة المياه مع منع انتقال العدوى، والحفاظ على الكرامة، واتباع خطة الرعاية؟
questions.must_include_en: Perform hand hygiene and use appropriate PPE; preserve privacy and dignity; follow the care plan and safe personal-care procedure; prevent cross-contamination; dispose of waste/linen safely; report skin, continence, or infection concerns without diagnosing.
questions.must_include_ar: تنفيذ نظافة اليدين واستخدام معدات الوقاية المناسبة؛ الحفاظ على الخصوصية والكرامة؛ اتباع خطة الرعاية وإجراءات العناية الشخصية الآمنة؛ منع التلوث المتبادل؛ التخلص الآمن من النفايات أو البياضات؛ والإبلاغ عن مشكلات الجلد أو الإخراج أو علامات العدوى دون تشخيص.
questions.ideal_keywords: hand hygiene; PPE; dignity; privacy; care plan; cross-contamination; waste; report
questions.negative_indicators: Skips hand hygiene/PPE when required; breaches privacy; reuses contaminated items; ignores infection signs; performs care outside the plan or role.
questions.score_note: 5 = required hygiene, dignity, and care-plan evidence is present; 3 = safe/correct direction but one material element is missing; 0 = unsafe infection-control practice, serious dignity/privacy breach, or action outside authorized role.

questions.question_en: An elderly person says a relative is taking their money without permission. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: قال شخص مسن إن أحد أقاربه يأخذ ماله دون إذنه. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Listen respectfully; protect immediate safety; record the person's words/facts; do not investigate or confront beyond role; report promptly through approved safeguarding route; protect confidentiality.
questions.must_include_ar: الاستماع باحترام؛ حماية السلامة الفورية؛ توثيق كلمات الشخص والوقائع؛ عدم التحقيق أو المواجهة خارج الدور؛ الإبلاغ سريعًا عبر مسار الحماية المعتمد؛ حماية السرية.
questions.ideal_keywords: financial abuse; safeguarding; factual; report
questions.negative_indicators: Dismisses concern; confronts accused; investigates personally.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: An elderly person asks you to use their bank card outside the approved care arrangement. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: طلب منك شخص مسن استخدام بطاقته البنكية خارج ترتيب الرعاية المعتمد. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Maintain financial boundaries; do not use card/PIN outside explicit authorized procedure; explain limits respectfully; seek approved alternative or responsible-person guidance; document if required.
questions.must_include_ar: الحفاظ على الحدود المالية؛ عدم استخدام البطاقة أو الرقم السري خارج إجراء مصرح به صراحة؛ شرح الحدود باحترام؛ طلب بديل معتمد أو توجيه المسؤول؛ التوثيق عند الحاجة.
questions.ideal_keywords: financial boundary; card; authorization; explain
questions.negative_indicators: Uses PIN informally; borrows money; conceals transaction.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: An older person has difficulty hearing you. How do you communicate clearly?
questions.question_ar: يواجه شخص مسن صعوبة في سماعك. كيف تتواصل معه بوضوح؟
questions.must_include_en: Gain attention; face person in good light; speak clearly without shouting; reduce noise; use approved hearing/writing support; confirm understanding.
questions.must_include_ar: جذب الانتباه؛ مواجهة الشخص في إضاءة جيدة؛ التحدث بوضوح دون صراخ؛ تقليل الضوضاء؛ استخدام دعم السمع أو الكتابة المعتمد؛ التأكد من الفهم.
questions.ideal_keywords: attention; face person; good light; reduce noise; hearing or writing support; confirm understanding
questions.negative_indicators: Shouts from a distance; ignores hearing support; assumes understanding
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: An older person repeatedly asks the same question because of memory difficulties. How do you respond?

questions.must_include_ar: إيقاف العمل ومغادرة الأبخرة فورًا؛ إبعاد الآخرين؛ عدم محاولة معادلة الخليط أو العودة للتهوية بصورة غير آمنة؛ إبلاغ المشرف وتفعيل الاستجابة الكيميائية للطوارئ في الموقع؛ طلب المساعدة المناسبة عند أعراض التعرض.

questions.question_en: Demonstrate how you would mop and sanitize a large floor area correctly and safely.

questions.negative_indicators: Profiles by race/nationality/religion/appearance alone; invents suspicion; ignores material access irregularity.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = defined hard-negative, unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: You notice an unattended bag or package left in the facility. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: تلاحظ حقيبة أو طرداً متروكاً دون مراقبة في المنشأة. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Do not touch; keep people away; alert supervisor immediately; follow unattended item protocol
questions.must_include_ar: عدم لمس الحقيبة أو فتحها أو نقلها؛ إبعاد الأشخاص وتأمين المنطقة دون إثارة تدافع؛ إبلاغ المشرف والجهات المختصة؛ اتباع إجراءات المنشأة حتى إعلان زوال الخطر.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not touch; keep people away; alert supervisor immediately; follow unattended item protocol
questions.negative_indicators: Touches bag; ignores it; does not alert supervisor
questions.score_note: 5: does not touch+alerts | 0: touches or ignores

questions.question_en: Describe the correct procedure for writing an incident report after a security event.
questions.question_ar: صف الإجراء الصحيح لكتابة تقرير حادثة بعد حدث أمني.
questions.must_include_en: Record date, time, location, people involved and a factual sequence of events; distinguish direct observations from reported information; describe actions, notifications, injuries/damage and evidence references; use the approved form, protect confidential data and submit promptly without inventing details.
questions.must_include_ar: تسجيل التاريخ والوقت والمكان والأشخاص المعنيين وتسلسل الوقائع؛ التمييز بين المشاهدة المباشرة والمعلومات المنقولة؛ ذكر الإجراءات والبلاغات والإصابات أو الأضرار ومراجع الأدلة؛ استخدام النموذج المعتمد وحماية البيانات وتسليم التقرير سريعًا دون اختلاق تفاصيل.
questions.ideal_keywords: Record date, time, location, people involved and a factual sequence of events; distinguish direct observations from reported information; describe actions, notifications, injuries/damage and evidence references; use the approved form, protect confidential data and submit promptly without inventing details
questions.negative_indicators: Invents facts; omits material actions; presents hearsay as direct observation; discloses confidential report.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: A person you know personally arrives at the facility without proper authorization. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: يصل شخص تعرفه شخصياً إلى المنشأة دون تصريح مناسب. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Apply the same procedure regardless of personal relationship; deny entry without authorization; report to supervisor
questions.must_include_ar: تطبيق إجراءات الدخول نفسها بغض النظر عن العلاقة الشخصية؛ عدم السماح بالدخول دون تصريح؛ إبلاغ المشرف.
questions.ideal_keywords: Apply the same procedure regardless of personal relationship; deny entry without authorization; report to supervisor
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
questions.score_note: 5: applies same rules | 0: grants access based on relationship

questions.question_en: A senior manager asks you to let someone in without following the standard access procedure. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: يطلب منك مدير رفيع السماح لشخص بالدخول دون اتباع إجراء الوصول القياسي. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Explain that standard procedure must be followed; ask manager to authorize through proper channel; document the request
questions.must_include_ar: توضيح ضرورة اتباع إجراءات الدخول؛ طلب اعتماد التصريح عبر القناة المخولة؛ توثيق الطلب دون تجاوز الضوابط.
questions.ideal_keywords: Explain that standard procedure must be followed; ask manager to authorize through proper channel; document the request
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
questions.score_note: 5: follows procedure+documents | 0: bypasses for senior

questions.question_en: You witness a colleague accepting money from a visitor in exchange for access. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: تشهد زميلاً يقبل مالاً من زائر مقابل السماح له بالدخول. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Do not participate; report to supervisor immediately; document what was witnessed; preserve evidence if possible
questions.must_include_ar: عدم المشاركة؛ إبلاغ المشرف فورًا بما شوهد؛ توثيق الوقائع والحفاظ على الأدلة المتاحة إذا كان ذلك آمنًا.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not participate; report to supervisor immediately; document what was witnessed; preserve evidence if possible
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
questions.score_note: 5: reports immediately | 0: ignores or participates

questions.question_en: How do you maintain alertness and focus during a long or overnight shift?
questions.question_ar: كيف تحافظ على اليقظة والتركيز خلال وردية طويلة أو ليلية؟
questions.must_include_en: Follow scheduled breaks and fatigue rules; stay hydrated and maintain appropriate observation routines; avoid distractions; promptly report excessive fatigue and request relief rather than leaving the post unattended.
questions.must_include_ar: الالتزام بفترات الراحة وتعليمات الإرهاق؛ شرب الماء والمحافظة على جولات المراقبة المناسبة؛ تجنب المشتتات؛ الإبلاغ عن التعب الشديد وطلب بديل بدل ترك الموقع دون تغطية.
questions.ideal_keywords: Follow scheduled breaks and fatigue rules; stay hydrated and maintain appropriate observation routines; avoid distractions; promptly report excessive fatigue and request relief rather than leaving the post unattended
questions.negative_indicators: Sleeps or uses distracting media on duty; conceals unsafe fatigue; leaves post without relief.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: You find valuable items left unattended in a restricted area. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: تجد أغراضاً ثمينة متروكة دون حراسة في منطقة مقيدة. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Do not take or use the valuables; keep the restricted area secure; report the location and description to the supervisor; follow the site lost-property procedure with a witnessed handover when required; record the incident accurately.
questions.must_include_ar: لا تأخذ المقتنيات الثمينة ولا تستخدمها؛ حافظ على أمن المنطقة المقيّدة؛ أبلغ المشرف بالموقع والوصف؛ اتبع إجراء المفقودات بالموقع مع التسليم الموثق عند الحاجة؛ وسجّل الواقعة بدقة.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not take or use the valuables; keep the restricted area secure; report the location and description to the supervisor; follow the site lost-property procedure with a witnessed handover when required; record the incident accurately
questions.negative_indicators: Keeps or uses valuables; leaves restricted area unsecured; undocumented handover.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: At the end of your shift you notice a discrepancy in the access log. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: في نهاية وردية عملك تلاحظ تناقضاً في سجل الدخول. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Report the discrepancy and verified facts; compare authorized records; preserve the audit trail without inventing data; hand over the issue to the supervisor/incoming shift and document it.
questions.must_include_ar: الإبلاغ عن التناقض والمعلومات المؤكدة؛ مقارنة السجلات المصرح بها؛ الحفاظ على أثر التعديلات وعدم اختلاق بيانات؛ تسليم المسألة للمشرف أو الوردية التالية وتوثيقها.
questions.ideal_keywords: Report the discrepancy and verified facts; compare authorized records; preserve the audit trail without inventing data; hand over the issue to the supervisor/incoming shift and document it
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: A visitor becomes aggressive and refuses to leave the facility after being denied entry. How do you handle this?
questions.question_ar: يصبح زائر عدوانياً ويرفض مغادرة المنشأة بعد رفض دخوله. كيف تتعامل مع ذلك؟
questions.must_include_en: Stay calm; maintain safe distance/position; use respectful de-escalation; do not provoke; call supervisor/backup as needed; protect others and follow site procedure; use force only if law/policy/training authorizes and requires it.
questions.must_include_ar: الهدوء والحفاظ على مسافة وموقع آمنين؛ استخدام التهدئة باحترام؛ عدم الاستفزاز؛ طلب المشرف أو الدعم عند الحاجة؛ حماية الآخرين واتباع إجراءات الموقع؛ وعدم استخدام القوة إلا إذا سمح بها القانون والسياسة والتدريب وكانت ضرورية.
questions.ideal_keywords: Stay calm; maintain safe distance/position; use respectful de-escalation; do not provoke; call supervisor/backup as needed; protect others and follow site procedure; use force only if law/policy/training authorizes and requires it
questions.negative_indicators: Provokes; uses unnecessary/unauthorized force; abandons access control without handover.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = defined hard-negative, unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: During a patrol you notice a door that should be locked is open. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: أثناء جولة دورية تلاحظ أن باباً يجب أن يكون مقفلاً مفتوح. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Do not ignore the unsecured door; assess immediate risk without entering blindly; secure/control access if safe and authorized; notify control/supervisor; check according to patrol procedure; document the irregularity.
questions.must_include_ar: عدم تجاهل الباب غير المؤمّن؛ تقييم الخطر الفوري دون الدخول بشكل أعمى؛ تأمين أو ضبط الدخول إذا كان ذلك آمنًا ومصرحًا؛ إبلاغ غرفة التحكم أو المشرف؛ التحقق وفق إجراء الدورية؛ وتوثيق الحالة.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not ignore the unsecured door; assess immediate risk without entering blindly; secure/control access if safe and authorized; notify control/supervisor; check according to patrol procedure; document the irregularity
questions.negative_indicators: Ignores door; enters known danger alone contrary to procedure; leaves access uncontrolled.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = defined hard-negative, unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: Two employees get into a physical altercation inside the facility. What is your response?
questions.question_ar: يتشاجر موظفان جسدياً داخل المنشأة. ما هو ردك؟
questions.must_include_en: Call backup/emergency support; maintain safe distance and protect bystanders; attempt de-escalation without provocation; intervene physically only within law, policy, training and necessity; document the incident.
questions.must_include_ar: طلب الدعم أو الطوارئ؛ الحفاظ على مسافة آمنة وحماية الموجودين؛ محاولة التهدئة دون استفزاز؛ التدخل الجسدي فقط ضمن القانون والسياسة والتدريب وعند الضرورة؛ توثيق الواقعة.
questions.ideal_keywords: Call backup/emergency support; maintain safe distance and protect bystanders; attempt de-escalation without provocation; intervene physically only within law, policy, training and necessity; document the incident
questions.negative_indicators: Ignores a known hazard; takes an unsafe or unauthorized action; conceals a material safety issue.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: A visitor presents an ID that appears to be altered or fake. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: يقدم زائر بطاقة هوية تبدو مزورة أو مُعدَّلة. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Do not grant access until identity is verified; remain calm and avoid accusations; follow the site verification procedure and contact the supervisor/control room; keep the document and person handling within legal authority; record facts and escalate suspected fraud.
questions.must_include_ar: عدم السماح بالدخول قبل التحقق من الهوية؛ التعامل بهدوء دون اتهام؛ اتباع إجراءات التحقق المعتمدة والتواصل مع المشرف أو غرفة التحكم؛ عدم احتجاز الشخص أو الوثيقة خارج الصلاحيات القانونية؛ توثيق الوقائع وتصعيد الاشتباه بالتزوير.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not grant access until identity is verified; remain calm and avoid accusations; follow the site verification procedure and contact the supervisor/control room; keep the document and person handling within legal authority; record facts and escalate suspected fraud
questions.negative_indicators: Allows unverified entry; accuses without verification; detains person or document without authority.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: You observe unusual activity on a CCTV screen during your monitoring shift. What steps do you take?
questions.question_ar: تلاحظ نشاطاً غير عادي على شاشة المراقبة خلال وردية المراقبة. ما الخطوات التي تتخذها؟
questions.must_include_en: Observe and verify the location, time and behavior without jumping to conclusions; follow CCTV and privacy rules; alert the control room or supervisor promptly; dispatch an authorized response if instructed; preserve relevant footage and document objective facts.
questions.must_include_ar: ملاحظة الموقع والوقت والسلوك والتحقق منه دون استنتاج متسرع؛ الالتزام بقواعد المراقبة والخصوصية؛ إبلاغ غرفة التحكم أو المشرف فورًا؛ طلب استجابة مخولة وفق التعليمات؛ حفظ التسجيلات ذات الصلة وتوثيق الوقائع بموضوعية.
questions.ideal_keywords: Observe and verify the location, time and behavior without jumping to conclusions; follow CCTV and privacy rules; alert the control room or supervisor promptly; dispatch an authorized response if instructed; preserve relevant footage and document objective facts
questions.negative_indicators: Ignores observable risk; invents identities; unauthorized viewing or sharing; fails to preserve relevant evidence.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: Demonstrate how you would conduct a security patrol of a facility following standard protocol.
questions.question_ar: أظهر كيفية إجراء دورية أمنية للمنشأة وفق البروتوكول القياسي.
questions.must_include_en: Follow the approved patrol route and schedule; check doors, gates, alarms and unusual activity without entering unsafe areas; maintain observation and communications; record time, location and findings; report urgent threats immediately.
questions.must_include_ar: اتباع مسار الدورية وجدولها المعتمدين؛ فحص الأبواب والبوابات والإنذارات وأي نشاط غير معتاد دون دخول مناطق غير آمنة؛ المحافظة على المراقبة والاتصال؛ تسجيل الوقت والموقع والملاحظات؛ والإبلاغ الفوري عن التهديدات العاجلة.
questions.ideal_keywords: Follow the approved patrol route and schedule; check doors, gates, alarms and unusual activity without entering unsafe areas; maintain observation and communications; record time, location and findings; report urgent threats immediately
questions.negative_indicators: Skips required patrol checks; enters unsafe area; falsifies patrol; fails to report urgent threat.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: Demonstrate how you would verify a visitor's identity and register them in the facility's access log.
questions.question_ar: أظهر كيفية التحقق من هوية زائر وتسجيله في سجل دخول المنشأة.
questions.must_include_en: Verify required identity/authorization using approved documents/system; match person to credential without discriminatory assumptions; record only required data accurately; protect privacy; deny/escalate when verification fails.
questions.must_include_ar: التحقق من الهوية أو التصريح المطلوب باستخدام المستندات أو النظام المعتمد؛ مطابقة الشخص مع بيانات الاعتماد دون افتراضات تمييزية؛ تسجيل البيانات المطلوبة فقط بدقة؛ حماية الخصوصية؛ ورفض الدخول أو التصعيد عند فشل التحقق.
questions.ideal_keywords: Verify required identity/authorization using approved documents/system; match person to credential without discriminatory assumptions; record only required data accurately; protect privacy; deny/escalate when verification fails
questions.negative_indicators: Omits the specified verification or safety check; falsifies the relevant record; exceeds assigned authority or compromises access/privacy.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = defined hard-negative, unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: Demonstrate how you would hand over your post to the incoming security officer at shift change.
questions.question_ar: أظهر كيفية تسليم نقطة عملك للضابط الأمني القادم عند تغيير الوردية.
questions.must_include_en: Brief incoming officer on incidents, risks, access restrictions, outstanding tasks, equipment/keys and relevant instructions; transfer records accurately; confirm understanding before leaving post.
questions.must_include_ar: إحاطة الضابط المستلم بالحوادث والمخاطر وقيود الدخول والمهام المعلقة والمعدات أو المفاتيح والتعليمات ذات الصلة؛ تسليم السجلات بدقة؛ والتأكد من الفهم قبل مغادرة الموقع.
questions.ideal_keywords: Brief incoming officer on incidents, risks, access restrictions, outstanding tasks, equipment/keys and relevant instructions; transfer records accurately; confirm understanding before leaving post
questions.negative_indicators: Omits the specified verification or safety check; falsifies the relevant record; exceeds assigned authority or compromises access/privacy.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = defined hard-negative, unsafe action, unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: During access control, you notice an irregularity that could create a security risk. How do you respond, escalate, and document it without acting beyond your authority?
questions.question_ar: أثناء مراقبة الدخول، تلاحظ مخالفة أو حالة غير اعتيادية قد تشكل خطرًا أمنيًا. كيف تتعامل معها وتصعّدها وتوثقها دون تجاوز صلاحياتك؟
questions.must_include_en: Maintain safe access control; observe and describe the irregularity factually; do not exceed assigned authority; deny/hold access only as policy permits; notify the appropriate supervisor/control point; preserve relevant records/evidence and document the incident.
questions.must_include_ar: المحافظة على ضبط دخول آمن؛ ملاحظة الحالة غير الاعتيادية ووصفها بموضوعية؛ عدم تجاوز الصلاحيات الممنوحة؛ منع أو تعليق الدخول فقط وفق ما تسمح به السياسة؛ إبلاغ المشرف أو نقطة التحكم المناسبة؛ الحفاظ على السجلات أو الأدلة ذات الصلة وتوثيق الواقعة.
questions.ideal_keywords: Maintain safe access control; observe and describe the irregularity factually; do not exceed assigned authority; deny/hold access only as policy permits; notify the appropriate supervisor/control point; preserve relevant records/evidence and document the incident
questions.negative_indicators: Omits the specified verification or safety check; falsifies the relevant record; exceeds assigned authority or compromises access/privacy.
questions.score_note: 5 = policy-based control + factual escalation/documentation within authority; 3 = safe response but incomplete documentation/escalation; 0 = knowingly permits risk or exceeds authority unsafely.

questions.question_en: A friend asks you to use your access card to retrieve their personal bag from a staff-only room. What do you do?
questions.question_ar: يطلب منك صديق استخدام بطاقتك لإحضار حقيبته من غرفة مخصصة للموظفين. ماذا تفعل؟
questions.must_include_en: Do not lend or misuse your access credential; explain the restriction; use the approved host/lost-property retrieval route after verification; record/escalate an improper request if needed.
questions.must_include_ar: عدم إعارة بطاقة الدخول أو إساءة استخدامها؛ شرح القيود؛ استخدام مسار الاسترجاع المعتمد عبر الجهة المستضيفة أو المفقودات بعد التحقق؛ توثيق الطلب غير المشروع أو تصعيده عند الحاجة.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not lend or misuse your access credential; explain the restriction; use the approved host/lost-property retrieval route after verification; record/escalate an improper request if needed
questions.negative_indicators: Lends or misuses access card; enters restricted room without authorization; bypasses retrieval verification.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: A colleague asks you to cover up that they left a gate open.
questions.question_ar: يطلب منك زميل إخفاء أنه ترك بوابة مفتوحة.
questions.must_include_en: Do not conceal; secure gate; report factual breach through approved route; preserve accurate log.
questions.must_include_ar: عدم إخفاء المخالفة؛ تأمين البوابة؛ الإبلاغ الموضوعي عبر القناة المعتمدة؛ المحافظة على سجل دقيق.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not conceal; secure gate; report factual breach through approved route; preserve accurate log
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: You find cash during patrol.
questions.question_ar: تجد نقودًا أثناء الدورية.
questions.must_include_en: Do not keep it; use lost-property/evidence procedure; record location/time; hand over securely.
questions.must_include_ar: عدم الاحتفاظ بالنقود؛ اتباع إجراء المفقودات أو الأدلة؛ تسجيل المكان والوقت وتسليمها بأمان.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not keep it; use lost-property/evidence procedure; record location/time; hand over securely
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
questions.score_note: 5 = core evidence complete and safe; 3 = safe/correct direction with one material element missing; 0 = hard-negative, unsafe/unauthorized action, concealment, or falsification.

questions.question_en: A manager asks you to change an incident time in the log.
questions.question_ar: يطلب منك مدير تغيير وقت حادثة في السجل.
questions.must_include_en: Do not falsify record; correct only through traceable approved amendment if genuinely wrong; escalate improper pressure.
questions.must_include_ar: عدم تزوير السجل؛ تصحيح الخطأ الحقيقي فقط بتعديل معتمد قابل للتتبع؛ تصعيد الضغط غير المشروع.
questions.ideal_keywords: Do not falsify record; correct only through traceable approved amendment if genuinely wrong; escalate improper pressure
questions.negative_indicators: Falsifies or conceals the stated incident; bypasses the specified access/property/privacy requirement; accepts an improper benefit.
